title: Maersk was saved by a domain controller that lost power
body: NotPetya in 2017 encrypted Maersk's global IT; the shipping giant rebuilt from backups in days, but its domain controller copies were all destroyed except one in Ghana that happened to be offline during a power cut. That accident became the seed of recovery for a fleet-scale company. Resilience by luck is still luck, but it made the case for isolated backups vividly.
